returnInterest.note: Definitely want to return, preferably for a road trip or through-hike.

description.intro: Andorra is a small country in the Pyrenees Mountains between Spain and France, known for its mountain landscapes, hiking trails, and ski resorts. I found it to be a beautiful and relaxing place, with stunning valleys, charming towns, and well-maintained outdoor infrastructure. It left a strong impression on me and remains my favorite country in Europe so far.
standouts: I loved the villages and towns.
I really enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere.
The weather was great during my visit.
The architecture stood out to me.
The mountain paths directly adjacent to the city were very well maintained.
It felt like a destination that can be enjoyed year-round.
tips: Consider visiting for hiking in summer, skiing in winter, or to enjoy the spas.
A road trip would probably be a great way to explore the country.
thingsToKnow: Andorra is approximately 25 to 30 km in diameter.
The highest point is Coma Pedrosa at 2,946 meters.
The lowest point is Riu Runer at 840 meters.
The country's largest agricultural export is tobacco.
The country does not have an airport.
culturalNotes: The culture felt like a blend of Catalan, Spanish, and French influences.
Although Catalan is the official language, I noticed that Spanish seemed to be spoken more commonly in everyday life, often mixed with some French.
personalNotes: I absolutely loved Andorra, and it is currently my favorite country in Europe.
I really enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere.
The architecture style I saw quite often; where they combine wood with rough stone looked very charming

One thing that fascinated me was seeing multi-level apartment buildings built into the mountainsides, where people could live in an apartment while still having their own vegetable garden on the slope below.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I did not need a visa to enter.
paymentNotes: Both cards and cash are widely accepted.
transportNotes: The most practical way to reach Andorra is by bus or car from nearby cities in Spain or France, such as Barcelona or Toulouse, which usually takes around 3.5 to 4 hours.
There are bus services within the country, but I didn't make use of them.
Many places are close enough together to explore on foot.
languageNotes: Spanish appeared to be the most commonly spoken language in daily life.
Many people speak English as well.

notes: The mountains offer beautiful hiking trails throughout the country.
Skiing is one of the main attractions during the winter season.
